name: Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arrest and risk of execution of Tundu Lissu, Chair of Chadema, the main opposition party in Tanzania
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is stating its opinion and making requests. It condemns Tanzania's arrest of opposition leader Tundu Lissu on treason charges, which can carry the death penalty. It asks Tanzania to release him, stop cracking down on opponents, journalists and rights groups, and let the opposition party Chadema take part in the October 2025 elections. It also asks the European Union to watch his trial closely and to consider measures if the situation gets worse.

- No law changes; Parliament asks Tanzania to free Tundu Lissu and drop the charges.
- Affects Lissu, Tanzania's opposition, journalists and rights groups.
- Next: the EU is urged to monitor his trial and weigh measures if conditions worsen.
